name: warm_day_planned_window_natvent_start_1211
description: Warm morning, windows recommended 06:00–10:00, whole-house fan configured, outdoor 66F cooler than indoor 72F. A window opens at 08:00 inside the planned window. Issue #1211 (A3): the handler runs the nat-vent entry gate itself and starts natural ventilation.
source: Issue #1211 pending scenario (promote only with owner review)
notes: Issue #1211 (A3): fan-configured twin of golden warm_day_planned_window_no_fan_pauses. The gate passes (temperature + a working fan), so the handler starts nat-vent from the event itself.

Three-exercise protocol: (a) effectiveness: with the A3 change reverted the handler returns silently and the 12:00/08:00 assertion fails (no natural_ventilation); (b) docs: docs/08 and plans/1142 now say the planned window gates only the lazy sync; (c) occupant: if this regresses, the fan starts up to 30 minutes late against an open window while the AC cools into it.

Issue #1200 (2026-11-01, pending owner approval): a whole-house fan install requires at least one door/window sensor; a sensorless WHF is unsupported. The scenario now configures binary_sensor.living_room_window so it runs in a supported configuration. In the engine-only harness the WHF safety logic already saw one sensor (the harness's open-sensor tracker), so this edit only makes the config say what the run already modelled: assertions and the full event log are unchanged.

events.note: Early morning: indoor 72F, outdoor 66F — conditions favorable for natural ventilation
Warm-day classification: windows recommended 06:00–10:00, hvac_mode=off for the window period
Window opens at 08:00 — inside the planned 06:00–10:00 window. Issue #1211: the handler runs the nat-vent gate (refused: no fan) and pauses.

assertions.reason: Warm-day classification applied: hvac_mode=off, windows_recommended=True with 06:00–10:00 window
Window opened inside the planned period with a working fan and favourable temperatures: the handler starts nat-vent directly (Issue #1211 A3).

verdict.summary: Window inside the planned period starts nat-vent from the handler
verdict.expected_behavior: Nat-vent starts at the debounce expiry, not at the next refresh
